chunks: Women were mentioned in the presence of Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, so he said:
It is not appropriate for a woman to walk in the middle of the road; rather, she should walk along the side of the wall.

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan, the Imam addressed in the report
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not appropriate or fitting

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام say about how a woman should walk in the street?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys an instruction in public etiquette and modest conduct for women. It presents a preference for walking at the side rather than in the middle of the road, reflecting decorum and social propriety in conduct.
